stem: Meena is helping in her school garden. She pulls out a wheat plant and sees that its roots are a bunch of many thin roots of nearly the same size, with no single main root. Which type of root system does the wheat plant have?

teacher.key_rationale: Wheat has many thin roots of similar size arising together with no main root, which is the definition of a fibrous root system; taproot (A) is the contrasting trap for students who do not check the root evidence.
